description: 'Decommission prep' PR flips three root variables in terraform.tfvars for the prod orders database (deletion_protection false, skip_final_snapshot true, backup_retention 14 -> 0), which reach the RDS instance through the postgres module's inputs as an in-place update. Noise: an Owner default tag, a lower slow-query threshold in the orders parameter group, a looser queue-age alarm and a new order.split event stream.

material.why: Nothing is replaced, which is why it is easy to wave through, but all three safety nets on the production orders database go at once: backup_retention_period 0 turns off automated backups and deletes the existing automated backups and point-in-time recovery when applied (with a brief outage on the switch), deletion_protection false lets the next PR or a stray destroy delete the instance, and skip_final_snapshot true means that delete keeps no final snapshot. The data migration to Aurora has not happened yet.
